lines.en: : We’re hooooooome!
: Oh, hey. It’s the only two people in Kumon-mi that I like, inconspicuously showing up at the dorm together just before midnight.
: Hey, Io. I’m surprised to see you still awake.
Uta tosses her hat and scarf onto an already large pile of clothes on the floor before taking her place next to Io.
: Sensei and I did karaoke together!
: Well, I did karaoke.
: Sensei just stood there all night and watched me because he’s a creep.
She conveniently leaves out the part where we almost kissed.
: Did you have fun?
: Lots.
: You should have invited me. I would have definitely come if it was just you two.
: Do you sing as well, Io?
: Nope! I’m horrible. But I could have joined you in being creepy and just staring at Uta as she dances around in circles all night.
: What a surprise that you and I are on the same page once again.
: Yeah, yeah. Get a room.
: Maybe some other time. I actually have to run over to my aunt’s really quick because I just realized I left my phone over there.
: Can I trust you to take care of our teacher for the next thirty minutes or so without me?
: I don’t know, Io. He’s always lookin’ at me with this weird fire in his eyes like he’s preparing to devour me whole.
: I’d feel a lot safer with your supervision.
: Sensei, will you be a good boy and promise to not devour Uta while I’m at my aunt’s house?
: No. She is doomed.
: Welp, I’ve done all I can.
: Thank you for trying. If you are unable to find my body when you come home, please tell my parents I love them and my brother that he is an idiot.
: Will do.
: Um...if you’re gone by the time I get back...is it okay if I text you to say goodnight and stuff?
: Sure. It’s already extremely late, so I imagine I'll be gone by then anyway.
: I’m pretty sure Uta only invited me here to seduce me. And I doubt that will take long since I’m always staring at her with fire in my eyes or whatever it was she said.
: Okay! Yeah! I’ll...get going then!
: See ya!
Io quickly puts her shoes on and darts out of the room, immediately thrusting Uta and I into yet another situation where we’re alone...
Which, I’m pretty sure, is what she was inviting me here to get away from.
: She didn’t even react to you saying I was gonna seduce you...
: She either trusts you wholeheartedly or is completely open to the idea of you and I hooking up on your side of the room.
: Sorry, Sensei. You know the rule about my parents, and there’s no way I’d be able to call them this late without waking them up and getting them all grumpy.
: Then it appears we will have to continue awkwardly flirting with one another and pretending we never-
: Yeah, yeah. A thing happened and now you think you’re a step closer to gettin’ your hands on the goods.
: Only problem is that the goods are out of stock and you’ve gotta wait for the store to replenish ‘em.
: Would you mind telling me when the next shipment is so I can mark my calendar?
: Sorry, no. We closed for good and aren’t accepting deliveries anymore.
: I’m beginning to think your objective tonight was to just make me want you even more than I already do.
: I don’t really have objectives. I kinda just do what I do and hope nothing explodes as a result.
: I don’t have a problem with you wanting me and stuff, though.
: So if tonight somehow made you want me more for...reasons...that’s totally okay.
: Not that I think you’d be able to help yourself to begin with. I can basically buy a house with all of the money you’ve given me.
: Stop taking advantage of my heart. It’s not fair.
: ...What do you know about “fair?”
: Hm? What was that?
: I said...what do you know about chairs!
: ...Chairs?
: Yeah! Cause...we should sit...and...since there’s no good place...how about the kotatsu?!
: Do you actually think that was a good cover?
: Don’t know! But I’m not about to wait around and find out! My feet are killin’ me.
: So either sit down or get the heck out, mister.
: Can we not sit on the bed instead?
: After what happened earlier? Heck no we can’t. I ain’t trying to lose my virginity in the thirty minute window of Io going to get her phone.
: What if she calls one of us right before it goes in and I get surprised and jump and then it splits me in half and there’s blood everywhere?
: Does that sound fun to you?
: I mean...up until the “blood everywhere” part...
: Just sit down, you friggin’ horndog...
I take my shoes off and sit in the same spot where Io passed out on my lap the other day.
Uta does the same after grabbing a carton of strawberry milk out of Io’s mini fridge and, within a matter of seconds, things start going back to normal.
I guess “normal” is a pretty subjective term when it comes to my relationship with Uta, though, as I’m learning now that it hasn’t even really begun yet.
There’s clearly a lot that I don’t yet understand about her, and I feel like it wouldn’t be too much of a stretch to imagine that there’s a lot she doesn’t understand about herself yet either.
Granted, I could be completely wrong considering when I confronted her about her selflessness, she immediately refuted it.
Either way, the uncomfortable air blends in with the typical wood stain scented air of her dorm room and things, once again, move into an area of conversation we’re both more comfortable with.
: Io’s great, isn’t she?
That area being talking about others instead of talking about ourselves.
: She said the same thing about you the other day.
: Oooooh...what else did she say? Anything juicy?
: I’ve always been curious about what she says about me while I’m not around.
: Only issue is that she never talks to anybody, so this is the first chance I’ve had to find out.
: She said a few things. But the one that stuck out most to me is that you “got better.”
: Whatever that means.
: Should we deflect this conversation topic as well?
: Yeah. My brain’s already overloaded from almost locking lips with you earlier and I’d rather not get into what that means right now.
: We can keep talking about Io, though! Just nothing bad, because she’s my BFF and I don’t wanna say mean stuff about her behind her back.
: Fine. But I’m going to let you lead the conversation since you’re the one who’s done nothing but show opposition to pretty much everything since we stepped into the karaoke booth.
: Done deal! Trust in Uta and you shall receive the best darn conversation you’ve had all night!
: The competition is very weak, all things considered.
: Shush.
: She hasn’t told me about it, but...based on the way she acted around you tonight, I bet that...
: She told you she likes you.
: Perceptive.
: Did she give you the robot or did she chicken out? I think that one could have gone either way.
: The robot is now living on a table in my bedroom.
: Awwwwww, that’s so cute.
: She likes you a lot, you know. Which means you’re the first crush she’s ever had.
: Which means she’ll take it a bajillion times harder if you do anything to make her sad.
: Like kissing her best friend?
: Guh. Well, at least we lasted a solid two minutes without bringin’ it up. But yes, like kissing her best friend.
: To move away from Io territory for a second...what about you, Uta?
: Hm? What about me?
: Who was your first crush?
: Hmm...good question. Who was my first crush?...
: Maybe Spongebob?
: What?
: You know. The cartoon sponge. Hangs out with a starfish.
: Your first crush was on a cartoon sponge?
: Sure. He was cute.
: I never wanted to do him or anything cause I was just a little girl, but I used to talk about marryin’ him and stuff.
: You have come a very long way, Uta.
: I’ve had all kinds of crushes before.
: Cartoons. Boys. Girls.
: I even had a crush on Io for a little while.
: Excuse me?
: Yup. You heard that right.
: Does...she know that?
: No. And she’s never gonna find out because, if you tell her, you’ll never see another flavor beam for the rest of your life.
: Do you still feel that way?
: Sensei, I mean it. Don’t even think about it.
: I’m not going to tell her. I’m just genuinely curious.
: No. I don’t feel that way anymore.
: It was only for a little while anyway. Like, barely even a couple weeks.
: I’ve just always had a hard time wrangling up my feelings and, before I know it, I wind up getting attached to stuff I don’t even have.
: It’s kinda pathetic, actually. And it’s made me do some really stupid stuff in the past.
: Buuuuuut that’s gettin’ a little too close to the “Uta doesn’t wanna talk about it right now” zone and I think it might be time for another topic change.
: What kind of stupid stuff?
: Sensei, I know you may be in love with me, but you really need to start payin’ attention to what I say and not just my boobs.
: I heard what you said, I’m just choosing to ignore it because I’m curious.
: Well that’s just plain rude and you’re a big ole jerk for doing that.
: Will you tell me eventually?
: Yes. Whether I want to or not.
: It’ll slip out because, contrary to what Io may have said about me, I’m not “better.”
: I just don’t say the same kinda stuff she says about herself because my brain is stupid and makes me think that anything that’s said out loud is real.
: So all of those smiles of yours are fake?
: Course not. Just cause you’ve gone through some stuff in the past and can’t really get over it doesn’t mean that everything for the rest of forever is gonna be sad.
: I’m super happy now. And I’ve got a bajillion good things going for me.
: There’s just also some stuff I’ve gotta bury if I’m ever gonna move on.
: So maybe that does make me “better” if that’s the word Io is gonna use. But it’s not the one I would pick.
: Now, can we stop talkin’ about depressing stuff and go back to flirting? Even the whole near kiss thing was better than this.
: Also, you made me admit I had a crush on a sponge and now I’m mad at you.
: Can I tell Io about the sponge crush or is that off limits too?
: Io knows about the sponge crush.
: And she still talks to you?
: Are you gonna stop talking to me because I had a crush on a sponge?!
: I can probably be convinced to keep associating with you.
: Ah! I knew you’d break out the blackmail sooner or later! It was only a matter of time!
: What do you want?! My first kiss? My first handie? My first child?
: Tell me, Sensei! What must you take from me?!
: Your phone number will suffice.
: Oh.
: That’s it?
: I’d also accept any of the three things you listed prior to my suggestion.
: No way. Not now that I know how easy it is to win you over.
: I forgot to add that I’ll also accept any sexy pictures you’d be willing to send me as a package deal with your phone number.
: That’s...not really something I can do...
: That’s fine. I wasn’t trying to push-
: No, like, I literally can’t do that. There are parental locks on my phone and I can’t send picture messages.
I’m going to have to add somebody else onto my phone plan, aren’t I?
: Just the number is fine, Uta.
: Done! Hand it over, Sensei.
: And get ready to be tossed into a group chat with me and Io so we all know what each other are doing every second of every day!
: I can guarantee that you do not want to know what I am doing for many seconds of many of those days.
: How come you’ve always gotta ruin everything?
Uta gives me her phone number, which means I have now conquered the seventh dorm room.
And even though she is literally incapable of sending me picture messages, I’m glad to see that we’re at least progressing in some way.
Or regressing, if her attitude toward what happened in the karaoke booth doesn’t change any time soon.
I’m not worried about that now, though.
I’ve learned a lot more about her today than any day before.
And even if there are parts of her that I won’t understand for months or years to come-
I’m sure those months will be exciting.
Congratulations! You now have Uta’s phone number!
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
